name: database-csv
description: CSV import + export for notion-database. CsvActions (Export + Import dropdown) + CsvImportDialog (file picker + column mapper) + csv.ts helpers (parseCsv / valueFromString / exportDatabaseToCsv / downloadCsv). Single-callback API — host owns persistence.
notes: CK-4 wave (2026-05-21) — lifted from notion-page-clone's database-csv sub-slice. Simplified vs upstream: dropped relation lookups (cross-DB context not exposed in standalone slice); dropped created_by / last_edited_by / rollup from COMPUTED_TYPES (not in rr PropertyType union). useStore replaced with single onImport callback. Pre-staged in template-base/notion/slices/database-csv/ since BS-wave.
